How Much Does It Cost to Build an App in 2026? Full Breakdown

By Chronolyte · Updated 2026-09-30

App development costs for 2026: simple, mid-complexity and complex apps, cost drivers, iOS vs Android vs cross-platform and ways to reduce your budget.

Short answer: a simple app costs about $15,000-$40,000, a mid-complexity app $40,000-$100,000, and a complex app (marketplace, real-time, payments, AI features) $100,000-$250,000+. Plan an extra 15-20% of the build cost per year for maintenance and updates.

App development cost by complexity

ComplexityTypical featuresTypical costTimeline
SimpleLogin, a handful of screens, basic API, no complex logic$15,000 - $40,0002 - 4 months
Mid-complexityPayments, push notifications, chat, maps, admin panel, third-party integrations$40,000 - $100,0004 - 7 months
ComplexMarketplace, real-time or video, AI/ML, offline sync, multiple user roles$100,000 - $250,000+6 - 12 months

Figures are typical market ranges in USD and vary by team location and scope. They are planning estimates, not quotes.

What drives app cost?

  • Platforms: iOS, Android or both. Two native apps cost more than one cross-platform codebase.
  • Design: custom UI, animation and branding take more time than standard components.
  • Back end: user accounts, databases, APIs and an admin dashboard are often half of the work.
  • Integrations: payments, maps, analytics, CRMs, SMS and email services.
  • Compliance: healthcare (HIPAA), payments (PCI) and privacy laws (GDPR) add effort.
  • Team model: freelancer, studio, or in-house — each has a different cost and risk profile.

iOS vs Android vs cross-platform

ApproachBest forCost impact
Cross-platform (React Native, Flutter)Most MVPs and business appsOne codebase for both stores — generally the most economical
Native iOS (Swift)iOS-only audiences, heavy device featuresHigher if you also need Android
Native Android (Kotlin)Android-heavy markets, deep system integrationHigher if you also need iOS
Progressive web appSimple tools that do not need app-store presenceLowest, but limited device access

Hidden and ongoing costs

  • Apple Developer Program (about $99 per year) and Google Play developer account (one-time registration fee).
  • Cloud hosting and third-party service fees that grow with users.
  • OS updates every year that require testing and fixes.
  • Customer support, analytics and marketing to acquire users.

How to reduce app development cost

  1. Build an MVP with one core user journey — not every feature you can imagine.
  2. Choose cross-platform unless you have a strong reason for native.
  3. Prototype in Figma and test with users before development.
  4. Use proven services (Stripe, Firebase, Twilio) instead of building from scratch.
  5. Release in phases and let real usage decide what you build next.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a simple app cost?

A simple cross-platform app typically costs $15,000-$40,000 and takes 2-4 months.

How long does it take to build an app?

Most MVPs take 2-4 months; mid-complexity apps 4-7 months; complex products 6-12 months or more.

Is it cheaper to build an app for iOS or Android?

Costs are similar for each platform. Building for both is where cross-platform frameworks save money.

Can I build an app without coding?

Simple apps can be built with no-code tools, but custom logic, performance and long-term scalability usually need developers.
